Its most coherent functional threads are RNA metabolism centered on YTHDC2, UPF1, UPF2, PUM1, CPSF1, and PPIL proteins; genome maintenance centered on ORC3, LRWD1, UHRF1, UBE2T, MPG, and TIMELESS; and transcriptional or translational support involving POLR3A, SUPT5H, EIF3L, and NARS1. SARM1 and ELP1 provide potentially relevant links to neuronal or autonomic biology, but the module as a whole is better interpreted as a broadly expressed cellular maintenance and gene-expression module than as a tissue-specific autonomic or kidney pathway.
rationale: ORC3, LRWD1, CPSF1, UHRF1, PUM1, UBE2T anchor the selected program. The interpretation gives dna replication, repair and cell division priority because these members form the clearest functional group in the reported composition. Translation and protein synthesis and Transcription and chromatin regulation also occur, but are treated as additional components rather than the module-wide principal theme. No GO or KEGG term passed global correction; the assignment rests on member functions and reported relationships.

description: The most coherent interpretation is an extracellular-matrix, basement-membrane, cell-adhesion, and tissue-interface module, with a possible contribution from protein trafficking and cellular stress handling. LAMC1 and LAMB1 are laminin subunits, COL12A1 is a fibril-associated collagen, CSPG4 is a cell-surface proteoglycan, and CADM3 is a cell-adhesion molecule. MFGE8 adds a secreted apoptotic-cell-clearance function, while IGF2R and HSPA5 support intracellular trafficking and protein-folding interpretations. MAP evidence, and tissue or cell-type context rather than on globally significant enrichment. The module is biologically coherent but not a formally enriched pathway.
rationale: CSPG4, CADM3, LAMB1, COL12A1, LAMC1, MFGE8 anchor the selected program. The interpretation gives extracellular matrix assembly and tissue architecture priority because these members form the clearest functional group in the reported composition. Cell adhesion and tissue interface signaling and Membrane trafficking and secretion also occur, but are treated as additional components rather than the module-wide principal theme. No GO or KEGG term passed global correction; the assignment rests on member functions and reported relationships.

description: This is a mixed lysosomal, cell-surface adhesion, endocytic, and neurovascular-associated module rather than a formally established pathway module. The most coherent functional signals come from ECE1, GLB1, and GUSB, which connect proteolytic or carbohydrate-processing biology with vesicular and lysosomal functions. TFRC adds receptor-mediated endocytosis and iron uptake, while CADM4, L1CAM, and BCAM add cell adhesion, membrane, neural, vascular, or extracellular-matrix interfaces. The network is connected but heterogeneous: ECE1 and GLB1 occupy the strongest central positions, with GUSB also linking the two lysosomal hydrolases, whereas the adhesion-associated genes form peripheral connections.
rationale: TFRC, GUSB, GLB1, CADM4, L1CAM, ECE1 anchor the selected program. principal_theme: Cell adhesion and tissue interface signaling
description: The module is most consistent with a cell-adhesion and tissue-interface program, combining neural or glial adhesion biology with extracellular-matrix interaction, migration, redox protection, and protease regulation. NCAM1 and NTM support neuronal, glial, neurite-outgrowth, and synapse-related biology; ALCAM, CD44, CXADR, PLXNB2, and COL6A1 support cell-cell or cell-matrix adhesion; TIMP1 supports extracellular-matrix protease inhibition and cytokine-responsive tissue remodeling; and SOD2 with TXN supports oxidative-stress control. These are functional annotations and network patterns rather than globally significant enrichment results. The STRING enrichment result was also empty, so the interpretation is based on gene-level annotations, topology, curated interactions, and complexes rather than significant pathway enrichment.
rationale: TIMP1, COL6A1, PLXNB2, CXADR, CD44, ALCAM anchor the selected program. description: The module is most consistent with a metabolic and cellular-trafficking program rather than a narrowly defined canonical pathway. The primary enrichment evidence is AMP binding GO:MF AMP binding, supported by ACSS2 and PYGL. ACSS2 is an acetate-activating enzyme that generates acetyl-CoA for lipid synthesis and energy generation, while PYGL mobilizes liver glycogen to release glucose-1-phosphate. The remaining genes broaden the interpretation: ATP6V1H supports V-ATPase-dependent organelle acidification, PRKCD participates in phosphorylation, stress responses and apoptosis, and MYO1B supports actin organization, endocytosis and post-Golgi vesicle transport. Because only the AMP-binding term passed global correction and there is no STRING functional enrichment, the metabolic interpretation is supported but should not be expanded into a claim of a fully established biochemical pathway.
rationale: MYO1B anchor the selected program. The interpretation gives membrane trafficking and secretion priority because these members form the clearest functional group in the reported composition. Cytoskeletal organization and contractility and Cell signaling and stress adaptation also occur, but are treated as additional components rather than the module-wide principal theme. Globally corrected enrichment includes AMP binding, interpreted alongside the member functions.

description: The strongest statistically supported interpretation is a nuclear, broadly cellular module rather than a single narrowly defined pathway. The sole globally corrected GO term is nuclear localization GO:CC nucleus, covering most module genes; the corresponding STRING nuclear component annotation (STRING Component Nucleus; within-query FDR = 0.011) is supplementary and consistent with it. The gene annotations suggest several connected processes: DNA replication initiation and checkpoint control through CDC6, POLA1 and TTI2; chromatin and DNA-damage responses through CHD1L, PIAS1 and RB1CC1; RNA processing and quality control through RNGTT, INTS9, CWC27, DCP1A, DHX36 and RNASEL; and intracellular transport or membrane-associated processes through XPO6, STXBP1, BNIP1 and EXOC3. Thus, the most defensible function is coordinated nuclear maintenance and proliferative or stress-response biology, with contributions from RNA handling, genome integrity, and intracellular trafficking.
rationale: RB1CC1, PIAS1, CHD1L, RNGTT, INTS9, CWC27 anchor the selected program. The interpretation gives rna processing and ribosome biogenesis priority because these members form the clearest functional group in the reported composition. Transcription and chromatin regulation and DNA replication, repair and cell division also occur, but are treated as additional components rather than the module-wide principal theme. Globally corrected enrichment includes nucleus, interpreted alongside the member functions.

description: The module is best interpreted as a liver-associated circulating secreted-protein module with a complement-centered core. C3 is the network hub and a central complement component, while CFB is an alternative-pathway component that contributes to the alternative-pathway C3 convertase. CP is a circulating copper-binding protein involved in iron handling and oxidant detoxification. SERPINA6 is a blood corticosteroid carrier, and TNC is an extracellular-matrix protein linked to cell adhesion, growth, epithelial morphogenesis, and wound response. The strongest biological theme is therefore complement and extracellular plasma biology, with associated redox, hormone-transport, and matrix-remodeling functions.
rationale: C3, CFB anchor the selected program. The interpretation gives innate immune and inflammatory defense priority because these members form the clearest functional group in the reported composition. Hemostasis and circulating protein transport and Extracellular matrix assembly and tissue architecture also occur, but are treated as additional components rather than the module-wide principal theme. No GO or KEGG term passed global correction; the assignment rests on member functions and reported relationships.
